say: Your end-to-end tests keep breaking. And nobody has time to write new ones.
caption: Your end-to-end tests keep breaking. And nobody has time to write new ones.

say: Meet Keep Green. Agentic AI as a service, for your end-to-end tests. Without the service.
caption: Meet KeepGreen: agentic AI as a service for your end-to-end tests. Without the service.

say: One command sets it up. It finds your app, uses your own AI key, and writes the workflows.
caption: One command sets it up. It finds your app, uses your own AI key, and writes the workflows.

say: Every week, the agent explores your app, finds the flows nobody tests, and opens a pull request with new tests. Each one passed five runs in a row.
caption: Every week the agent explores your app, finds untested flows and opens a PR with new tests. Each passed 5 runs in a row.

say: When your UI changes, it fixes the broken test and proves the fix. A real bug? You get an issue, not a hidden test.
caption: When your UI changes, it fixes the broken test and proves the fix. A real bug? You get an issue, not a hidden test.

say: No account. No vendor. No monthly bill. It runs in your own C.I., with your own key. Free and open source.
caption: No account. No vendor. No monthly bill. It runs in your own CI, with your own key. Free and open source.

say: Keep Green. Run N P X keep green init, and give us a star on GitHub.
caption: Run npx keepgreen init, and give us a ⭐ on GitHub.
